news.title: 州长们呼吁AI行动 - 美国国家州长协会（NGA）
news.snippet: [美国州长协会呼吁加快AI治理行动，强调州长处于AI技术开发与应用的最前线。]
news.raw_snippet: “Governors are on the frontlines of AI development in the states, implementing policies to advance American leadership and create jobs while guarding against safety risks and workforce disruption,” said NGA CEO Brandon Tatum. “It’s clearly time for a national AI approach, but no federal AI policy will be effective without governors’ input. Governors have an important role in ensuring that any federal framework for artificial intelligence preserves appropriate state authority. Governors formed [...] - Advance innovation AND protect the public: AI policies should strengthen and ensure dominance of American technological leadership and economic opportunity while protecting public safety, civil rights, and individual privacy. The United States will not win the AI technological race if the public does not have faith in its safety and that it will benefit the people. [...] “Artificial intelligence presents both opportunities and risks that are too big to ignore,” said Governor Josh Stein. “Governors are calling on the federal government to act to protect the public, support innovation, and preserve appropriate state authority. As states implement policies to prepare our workforce for opportunity, protect the public from harm, and transform how government can deliver for people, these bipartisan principles can help build the trust needed for innovation to thrive.”
